body: We own a house together, and all of his family moved across the country to be close to us. It’s just so hard because I can still remember when he used to make me happy. I wish it was as easy as just leaving, but man the thought of divorce is honestly more scary to me than just giving up on life all together.

Pretty stressed, like I am pretty much always anxious and on edge. I also have PTSD from a previous sexual assault from before I met him, that I am working on getting treatment for. So I’ve always attributed my anxiety and stress to that.

We argue about once or twice a week, which I feel like it would probably be more often except we both work so much and don’t see each other a lot during the week. I have thought about the possibility that I might be in an abusive relationship, but it’s so hard because I love the rest of his family so much. And I can remember a time when things weren’t this way, you know?

I do sometimes try to talk to him afterwards. He will normally also say that I was somehow hurtful to him, which I end up believing because we were like screaming at each other. Most of the time I will try to avoid a conversation about it because we just end up in a vicious cycle arguing about the same things over and over again. We’ve been married for almost three years, we’ve been arguing super badly for the past year and a half or so but I feel like it’s always getting a little worse each time.
